description: Above-100-TPS load sweep on unchanged optimized group-commit implementation. Four validator processes and one client share an 8-logical-CPU macOS AArch64 host. Real Ed25519 and durable journals; 20ms fixed one-way delay; 64-request/1ms group commit; 5s transaction deadline; five-second offered windows. Three repeats at 1000 and 1500 TPS; other loads single runs. Aggregate throughput includes drain; recovery is outside timed interval. No simultaneous builds/tests during measurements. Censored population percentiles retain stalls. This is a short-run load sweep, not a long-duration capacity or geographical deployment claim.

report.measurement_definition: Signed transaction submission before transport enqueue to client receipt and strict Ed25519 verification of effects QC; client generation/signing excluded; network queues, fixed per-direction delay, validator validation/signing and group sync_all before votes included.
report.limits: One host, loopback TCP, fixed one-way delay without packet-loss/bandwidth modelling; one hot collective pool; bounded journal group commit; filesystem/device sync_all guarantees assumed. Finalized latency percentiles are conditional; all-submitted quantiles include right-censored stalls.
